semantic_fragments.content: For all shock and vibration tests under clauses 10.1.3a1, 10.1.3a2, 10.1.3b1, and 10.1.3c, the assessment criterion is whether basic safety and essential performance is maintained (Yes/No) for each direction/axis combination. All listed test clauses are marked N/A for this report.
